# I198 parent disposition: technical improvements and three unpaid bridges

2026-10-12. **No substantial nomination. Eight accepted, two remaining.**
The Sol/high/ultrafast task completed with no pending child runs.
The [report](i198-geometry-representation-discovery.md) and
[analytic record](../experiments/i198_geometry_representation/analytic-attempt.md)
contain complete technical deductions, a counterexample, and explicit gaps.

## Parent mathematical assessment

The parent read both completed records, the reading and literature notes,
and the retained source passages covering the quadratic Foulkes induction
and sixth-power polarization lemma. The following written checks are
scoped parent checks, not the two independent acceptance gates.

**F210:** Canonical surjectivity for b>=(a-1)^2 follows from the displayed
induction. Put r=a-1 and m=b-r. The first derivative sequence has starting
weight m-i+1>=1. Induction applies because m>=r(r-1)>=(r-1)^2; the
a=2,b=1 case uses the identity in degree zero. In the final r blocks of
r transfers, the starting weight in block i is b-(i-1)r>=r. The whole-power
injectivity lemma explicitly present in the sixth-power companion covers
the equality endpoint. Thus the new numeric threshold is supported by
the two accepted source operations. This is a technical combination, not
an accepted ninth finding. The determinant examples correctly obstruct
the proposed ambient cancellation/polarization shortcuts, without being
claimed as canonical Foulkes kernels.

**Cylinder diagnostic:** For V(p)=Jp on the radius-rho disk, the swept
slice at height s has area pi rho^2(1+s^2). At L=1 the volume is
(8/3)pi rho^2 and the diameter is at most 2 sqrt(1+2rho^2). Fubini bounds
the length of every fiber by this diameter, so every finite cylinder cover
has total base area at least [4/(3 sqrt(1+2rho^2))]pi rho^2. At rho=1/10
this exceeds pi rho^2, whereas the proposed unchanged cost is smaller.
The counterexample is valid for the proposed trace-zero extension and
does not settle a corrected expansion-dependent covering problem.

**Cone deductions:** The g+tau I sign threshold and the epsilon^12 distance
estimate are recorded as technical consequences of the stated source
contracts. The parent checked the rank obstruction for Q+delta||y||^2 I
and the inverse-norm exponents in the distance estimate. This is not a
full independent audit of the large Hankel construction or an acceptance
claim for regularization stability. Full rank r of the perturbed Q at the
old patch is incompatible with its A-coordinate of rank N<r. A new
feasible patch, or another obstruction/lift construction, remains unpaid.

The literature record's reading limits are retained. The parent has not
independently verified worldwide novelty, every external theorem, or all
source proof components. None is necessary to increase a finding count
here: no candidate is being accepted.

## Follow-up decision

Rather than re-count the technical results, three disjoint follow-ups
will examine the actual missing bridges: (I199) structured Foulkes
annihilators/conductor bounds; (I200) the positive quadratic regularization
of the nonliftable cone; and (I201) a corrected elliptic covering cost with
a meaningful geometric consequence. Each must develop two routes,
check primary literature, and deliver a proved nomination or precise
unresolved outcome. Their outputs are separate and their scope excludes
reworking the already-paid numerical thresholds.

All agents use the user's selected GPT-6.1 Sol/high/ultrafast settings.
The E183/local-ear and Barnette fronts and the I197 narrow-gap branch
remain parked. Every future substantial nomination still needs separate
proof and contribution reviews.

# I200 parent disposition: large-delta lift, small-delta question unresolved

2026-10-12. **No substantial nomination. Eight accepted, two remaining.**
The [report](i200-regularized-cone-bridge.md) and
[analytic argument](../experiments/i200_regularized_cone/analytic-attempt.md)
were delivered by the completed Sol/high/ultrafast task with no pending
child runs. I199 and I201 were separately confirmed running; their files
were not read as dependencies or edited by this integration.

## Checked scope of the deductions

The parent read the full report and analytic record, the literature and
reading notes, and the source's complete cone/epigraph construction. Under
the stipulated source operations, the following written checks pass:

* Let L=[G_1 U|...|G_m U], C=L^T g L and v=L^T w. Since C=P-vv^T with
  P positive semidefinite, it has at most one negative eigenvalue. If it
  had none, a joint linear Gram factor would make the source K_0
  spectrahedral. Its accepted nonliftability excludes that case. Hence
  sigma=-lambda_min(C)>0 and sigma<=||v||^2.
* For delta>=sigma, factoring C+delta I gives a joint linear Gram factor
  of Q_delta. The source's skew-block construction is an affine pencil
  of size at most (r+1)(mr+1). Its generalized Schur complement depends
  only on Q_delta, so it agrees with the source cone even for singular X
  and even when the number of Gram columns differs from r+1.
* The alternative Gram cone is closed: integrating a represented biform
  on the product of unit spheres bounds the traces of its positive
  semidefinite Gram matrices. Subsequential compactness gives a limiting
  Gram matrix. This proves the attained threshold
  0<delta_SOS<=sigma for this particular method, not for arbitrary lifts.
* The denominator-cleared patch uses the degree-one homogeneity of
  tr(A^(-1)Q_delta(y)). Its graph equality is exact and its degree is at
  most 4r+4. The inverse-Hessian expansion in (A1) is correct; its kernel
  is radial when y!=0. The source epigraph supplies convexity of the
  remaining term. Thus the covariance contraction in (A2) is strictly
  positive for the displayed transverse immersed patch and a strictly
  positive affine moment functional. This patch cannot provide the
  desired negative moment defect.

These are scoped parent checks of technical statements, not independent
acceptance reviews. No assertion is made that absence of a bilinear Gram
factor rules out a more general finite semidefinite lift.

## Exact remaining gap and disposition

Liftability of K_delta for 0<delta<delta_SOS remains unresolved in this
record. A new obstruction would need valid control on the remaining
singular strata (y=0 and singular A), including the source's center and
analytic-selection quantifiers. A constructive resolution would need an
exact matching/lift argument valid at singular X. The positive square
root, a piecewise positivity certificate or an approximation alone is
not that argument.

The large-delta Gram construction and repaired-patch calculation do not
meet the substantial-contribution gate. The cone branch is parked pending
a new mechanism; I199 and I201 continue independently. No new agent is
launched merely to repeat either failed route.
